description: Functions, procedures, aggregates, and triggers catalogue scenarios
comment: Table-driven pack for Functions, procedures, aggregates, and triggers. Shared project template; each scenario overlays one declarative file.

scenarios.description: apply routine.sql with a native in-place operation
scenarios.comment: Covers PG-CAT-RTN-01::routine.sql. Keep public.transition_anchor identity stable.

forbiddenMigrationPatterns.description: does not replace the transition anchor
